title: Increase Tampermonkey @version on every userscript change
abstract: Every time a Tampermonkey userscript is changed, including during local iteration, increment its UserScript metadata @version to a strictly higher value. This keeps script revisions distinguishable for update detection; do not wait for a formal release or distribution.

source.reference: General versioning or MVP graduation expectation, normalized without private conversation content
